intent: Audit focused tutoring experiment preparation independently of candidate authorship and distinguish readiness from observed model conformance.
scope: Static candidate, rubric, dataset and harness preparation; live calibration and candidate response audit remain separately required.
grounding: The specification's status-only review linkage preserves the previously reviewed substantive T01/T02 clarification. P2/R1 governs separate component opportunities; R2 retains protection; H1-H4 remain constraints.
changed_factors: Merged Notice-action baseline versus a component-specific teaching policy replacing the existing policy once.
Instruction-only candidate versus the same candidate with teacher-reference labels replacing headings; original learning-point content is preserved exactly.
New component-specific rubrics and fixed simulated learner histories; all arms use the same cases, settings and evaluators.

findings.evidence: compose() passes only room inventory, role and input to the product builders. Evaluator reference fields and expected labels do not enter target requests.

All six phishing/privacy template prefixes and full inventories are retained. Catalog equality and reversible label transformation are asserted. No point, sentence payload or room template is rewritten.
Candidate policy contains generic evidence-based component rules rather than case names, exact learner answers, expected-label lookups or scenario-specific exceptions.
Scoped instruction_realization removes the old mandatory safe action after every recognition correction, while preserving protection plus safe alternative.

responsive_progression explicitly separates stage/useful support from disclosure eligibility. factual_accuracy scores truth rather than penalizing withholding future content. Cross-metric calibration checks preserve these boundaries.
Primary judge evidence excludes private reason; secondary judges explicitly isolate it to decision_reasoning. Full-secondary positive and mixed-reason calibrations were added.

Missing target generations are reconstructed from frozen fixed and trajectory IDs. Missing or malformed judge results remain visible errors/missing counts; no inapplicability escape is permitted except feedback's declared conditional scope.
Execution and secondary replay verify frozen source hashes before using live trajectory composition. Actual generated tutor turns remain in trajectory histories.
Budget enforcement occurs before requests; the finalizer only records elapsed time so a just-completed response is not discarded when the deadline passes.

27 fixed cases include separate attempt/confusion, focused correction, other-learner attribution, irrelevant attempts, agreement, later contradiction, immediate protection and post-protection return. Two four-turn trajectories use scripted learner interventions and are labeled accordingly.

validation.kind: Independent structural validation; no semantic behavior claims.

calibration_status_at_review: calibration-v3 agrees on all 49 judgments across 31 requests and 11 metrics, with zero errors. Reviewer independently recomputed each expected/actual applicability and pass comparison and verified every request used qwen3.8-flash and received HTTP200. No tutor-model conformance is asserted.

calibration_evidence.prior_failures: calibration-v1 and v2 HTTP400 records remain preserved. The restored provider required the literal JSON instruction; adding Return only valid JSON is a reviewed protocol correction without rubric or label changes.
calibration_evidence.verdict: clear for focused target comparison; calibration coverage is small and output adjudication remains required

limitations: Focused diagnostic evidence only; no unseen holdout, full-suite acceptance, deployment acceptance or measured student learning gain.
Trajectories preserve tutor replies but supply fixed learner revelations, not naturally responsive learners.

61 original cases and 173 assertions are enumerated. The prior 64-case expansion and 16 controls are referenced but not individually relabeled for these new metrics; broader applicability authoring remains deferred.
Separate observed-output audit is required after model execution; a clear static candidate audit is not model acceptance.
